study_identification_part.si_4_title: Using normative modelling to detect disease progression in mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease in a cross-sectional multi-cohort study

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Six datasets named in the Methods section.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "In our analysis, we used six datasets: the UK Biobank ..., the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) ..., the Australian Imaging Biomarkers and Lifestyle Study of Ageing (AIBL) ..., the Alzheimer's Disease Repository Without Borders (ARWiBo) ..., the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies: Cross-Sectional (OASIS-1) ..., and the Minimal Interval Resonance Imaging in Alzheimer's Disease (MIRIAD) ..."

answer.ADNI: clinical evaluation/testing of normative model performance (MCI/AD)

answer.AIBL: clinical evaluation/testing of normative model performance (MCI/AD)

answer.ARWiBo: clinical evaluation/testing of normative model performance (MCI/AD)

answer.OASIS-1: clinical evaluation/testing of normative model performance (AD)

answer.MIRIAD: clinical evaluation/testing of normative model performance (AD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: UK Biobank used to train autoencoders; other datasets used to assess normative model performance on MCI/AD.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "In the present study, we used the UK Biobank set to train the autoencoders and the ADNI, AIBL, ARWiBo, OASIS-1, and MIRIAD datasets to assess the normative model performance on data from patients with MCI and AD."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Overall HC count from UK Biobank; training used bootstrapped sets (n=11,032) sampled from UK Biobank.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Here, we used an early release of the project's data comprising of 11,034 HC participants." "We created 1,000 bootstrapped sets (each one with n = 11,032) by sampling with replacement from the UK Biobank. These bootstrapped sets were used to train the AAE."
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Pinaya2021.pdf.md: Methods / Datasets; Pinaya2021.pdf.md: Normative model training
